thread.title: Apple suppliers' stocks take a beating after revenue warning - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple suppliers' stocks take a beating after revenue warning - MarketWatch
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -10.03% suppliers took a beating in premarket trade Thursday, in the wake of Apple slashing its revenue outlook because of much weaker-than-anticipated iPhone sales in China. Shares of Lumentum Holdings Inc. LITE, -8.41% dropped 8.7% ahead of the open, Cirrus Logic Inc. CRUS, -8.46% slumped 8.5% and Qorvo Inc. QRVO, -9.07% gave up 5.3%. Lumentum and Qorvo had warned in November of revenue shortfalls, citing weakening demand for their smartphone customers. Shares of Austria-based AMS AG AMS, -23.17% which is also an Apple supplier, plunged 20% in overseas trading. Apple's stock had already tumbled 32% over the past three months through Wednesday, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -2.83% had shed 13%.
